Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest more than 21 years after every life in being, so it is void and the friend holds fee simple absolute.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” confines the aphorism to past progressive societies, and it is commonly misread as a prediction of future legal change.

Q5649.reason: Immediate post-operative care requires continuous free drainage and measured urine output, which is a standard reason not to use a catheter valve.
